verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only per-resource CRUD through the Public API, plus Reverse ETL and Audience syncs that move many records to destinations. None of it documents bulk or batch operations that let a user act on many workspace items at once. Reverse ETL and Audience syncs are data-pipeline features, not bulk operations, and per-item CRUD is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
